function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: 2015 年的國際象棋世界錦標賽（World Chess Championship）由挪威棋手馬格努斯·卡爾森（Magnus Carlsen）贏得。

In Chinese, "國際象棋錦標賽" could be "World Chess Championship". 2015 World Chess Championship was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. But maybe they refer to "2015 Chess Olympiad" which was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The winner was Russia. But the question: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" It's ambiguous. Usually "國際象棋錦標賽" refers to "World Chess Championship". So answer: Magnus Carlsen. Provide answer in Chinese.
